case_number: 2025 INSC 361; CIVIL APPEAL NO………………….OF 2025 (Arising out of S.L.P. (C) No. 4484 OF 2020)
summary: Motor accident compensation; quadriplegia with 100% permanent disability; enhancement of compensation justified; income assessed at ₹7,500/month with 40% future prospects; lumpsum for attendant (₹5,00,000), special diet (₹1,00,000), pain and suffering (₹1,00,000), future medical expenses (₹2,00,000), loss of marriage prospects (₹2,00,000), and physiotherapy (₹50,000); total compensation ₹36,84,000; insurance company directed to transfer amount within six weeks; multiplier of 18 applied; judicial notice taken of necessity for physiotherapy despite weak documentary evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment modified; total compensation enhanced to ₹36,84,000 with interest; respondent No.3/Insurance Company directed to deposit amount in claimant's bank account within six weeks.
